title: Custom CarPlay Widgets Glow Up on iOS 27 #shorts
description:
Custom CarPlay dashboard with widgets on iOS 27: how to customize your CarPlay screen. Watch the glow up from a plain map to pink music widgets, live lyrics and a custom start sound. Personalize your CarPlay in minutes.

CarPlay tips for drivers in the USA: Chicago, Dallas, Seattle, Atlanta.

Search Car Widgets: AutoDash on the App Store.
